_about: Source of truth for every photograph on the site. _src/build.py generates the portfolio grid, its ImageObject structured data, homepage/about image tags and the image inventory report from this file. 'original' files are the colour-managed BT.2020 AVIF exports and must never be recompressed (see README). 'slug' names the 600px (images/thumbs/) and 1200px (images/web/) JPEG derivatives. 'evidence' records where each fact comes from: 'pixels' = visible in the photograph, 'owner caption' = stated on the site by the owner before this audit, 'visual identification' = a landmark or species recognised in the pixels but not confirmed by the owner, 'unverified' = not confirmed. 'original_sha256' fingerprints each original so _src/validate.py fails if an original is ever modified.
